spans.s:
कीचक m. (-कः)
 1. A bamboo whistling or rattling in the wind.
 2. Any
hollow bamboo.
 3. A reed.
 4. A Daitya or infernal demon so
named.
 5. A particular Rākṣasa or goblin.
 6. A kind of tree.
 7. A
prince, the son of KEKAYA.
 E. चीक to touch, to sound, वुन् Uṇādi
affix, and the radical consonants transposed.

कीचकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of BHIMA.
 E. कीचक a goblin, and जित् who conquers.
कीचकनिसूदन m. (-नः) BHIMA: see the preceding.
कीचकभिद् m. (-भित्) See the two words preceding.
